release_role: User-selected final team web handover; not automatically deployed
architecture: ResNet50 encoder + five-stage GN8 U-Net decoder

input.normalization: /255 externally; ImageNet mean/std embedded exactly once

inference.averaging: inverse-align logits then mean; native bilinear logits align_corners=False; sigmoid once

output.probability_map: RAW native float32[H,W]; diagnostic only; do not threshold it for display
output.binary_mask: FILTERED native uint8[H,W] with values0/1; canonical displayed output
output.is_candidate: true iff filtered mask contains foreground

training.initialization: ImageNet V2 ResNet50 + random decoder; no positive-only segmentation initialization

evaluation_scope: Reused C6 test-set exploratory postprocessing; not independent clinical validation
